name: HuntScreens

sources.title: HuntScreens homepage - daily product/AI tool launch board
Launch Your Product - $0 queue (~30 days) vs $10 VIP 24h, plus $79 dofollow backlink and sidebar-ad add-ons

conditions: Free 'Queue' tier exists at $0 but review takes ~30 days
'VIP Pass' ($10, Stripe) skips the line with 24-hour review
A permanent DOFOLLOW backlink is only the $79 add-on — the free/base listing link type is not promised as dofollow
Login appears required (Log in button on the submit page)
requirements: Daily product board — new products are grouped under 'Today'/'Yesterday' with logo, name, and description
Refund policy acknowledged in the form: rejected products get a full refund; once published, no refunds
Product URL is the core field of step 3 of the submit flow
preparation: Product URL, name, one-line description, and logo
Decide between free queue (~30 days) and $10 VIP (24h)
Optional add-ons: $79 permanent dofollow backlink, sidebar ads ($29/7d, $99/30d), bundles (Launch Pack $99, Growth Pack $159)
workflow: Step 1: choose speed — 'Queue' ($0, ~30 days) or 'VIP Pass' ($10, 24h review)
Step 2: pick optional add-ons (dofollow backlink $79, sidebar ads, bundles) or skip
Step 3: enter the product URL and complete the product details; acknowledge the refund policy
Pay via Stripe if a paid option was chosen, submit, and wait for review
Published products appear on the daily board under /products/<slug>
watchFor: The page is an upsell ladder: base fee, then backlink add-on, sidebar ads, and 'bundle' framing — the free option exists but is visually de-emphasized ('VIP Pass Recommended')
The dofollow link is a $79 paid add-on — do not assume the free listing is dofollow
Guest posts are a separate paid product ($99, refunded if not accepted)
Site is open source (github.com/daimajia/huntscreens) — a Product Hunt-style clone; authority claims (DR 50+, 300K monthly visitors) are self-reported
Once published, no refunds even if the listing underperforms
countsAsLive: The product appears on the 'Today' board and has a public page at huntscreens.com/products/<slug>
unknowns: Whether the free-queue listing link is dofollow (catalog note says follow; the paid add-on language implies otherwise)
Current real queue depth for the free tier
Whether review checks product quality or just payment
